text: Cream standardised to at least 48 % fat. At that fat it is thick enough to spoon, whips easily and does not split in hot sauces.

sources.text: The table, the facts and the words on how it is made, from these.

steps.note: The cream is heated and then cooled quickly, for the extra-thick kind.
